subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Which diagnostics-otel default bucket policy should OpenClaw support for existing exported metrics: this narrow run/harness/context policy, the broader duration-metric policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098, or no default change until more proof exists?
rationale: Both open PRs use the right OpenTelemetry mechanism, but they change existing metric aggregation differently and that compatibility/product policy cannot be chosen safely by cleanup automation.

options.title: Choose one policy after proof
options.body: Require redacted real OTEL export output for the selected branch, then merge only the owner-approved bucket policy and close or supersede the other PR.

options.title: Accept this narrow policy
options.body: Merge this PR after proof if maintainers want only agent run, harness, and context histograms changed now, leaving broader duration metrics for later work.

options.title: Prefer the broader related PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098 as the canonical branch if maintainers want all millisecond duration metrics aligned before changing defaults.

recommendation.title: Choose one policy after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted real OTEL export output for the selected branch, then merge only the owner-approved bucket policy and close or supersede the other PR.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent diagnostics-otel metric and exporter history in the affected files.
